subject: Coinbase Q3 strategy, Circle distribution economics, Permission Coin ASK wallet integration, Japan SBIC identity and XRP derivatives

market_observation.methodology: Seven exchange perpetual OI; five exchange long/short and liquidation data. Liquidations are a lower bound.
market_observation.comparability_warning: Do not infer a change versus Liqwall's earlier $1.33B without matching exchange coverage, contract scope and observation time.

coinbase_q3_2026.interpretation: Q3 GAAP net income included $715.022M of gains on crypto assets held for investment, mainly fair-value remeasurement of BTC and ETH. Adjusted net income was $77.7M. Higher average USDC balances supported stablecoin revenue while lower interest rates offset part of that benefit.
coinbase_q3_2026.xrp_implication: These are Coinbase-wide platform metrics, not XRP-specific net purchases, collateral balances or settlement volume.

circle_h1_2026.limitation: Circle's transaction-volume and 77% market-share figures are issuer-reported aggregates, not unique payments, net economic settlement or XRPL/XRP-specific volume.

circle_binance_relationship.incentive_basis: Monthly incentive fee linked to USDC held through Circle Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure; Binance promotes USDC.
circle_binance_relationship.limitation: No XRP purchases, XRP market making or XRP reserve changes are specified.

permission_ask.custody_description: Permission says Coinbase secures the private key in its systems; Permission login authorizes transactions and key export is supported.
permission_ask.limitation: No direct ASK/XRP or ASK/XRPL integration is established by reviewed official docs. Cross-chain-ready wallet language does not establish XRPL support.

japan_sbic.resolved_entity: Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (東京中小企業投資育成株式会社; SBIC East Japan)
japan_sbic.business: Long-term equity investment and growth support for investee SMEs.
japan_sbic.chatgpt_event: Official 2025-06-12/13 generative-AI and ML training for investee companies, including ChatGPT and Copilot, delivered by VOST.
not_established: XRP or XRPL investment or integration
japan_sbic.disambiguation: Tokyo SBIC is a separate legal entity from SBI Holdings, SBI Ripple Asia, SBI VC Trade, and the Osaka and Nagoya regional corporations.
